name: Notebook
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Goal**: Add Jupyter notebook (`.ipynb`) sync functionality to a Vue.js chat application.
2. **`ChatFileList.vue`**: Added two new icon buttons (book-open & file-export) visible only for `.ipynb` files, emitting `sync-notebook` and `export-notebook` events.
3. **`ChatService` (`chat.js`)**: Implemented three new methods — `readNotebookAsMessages`, `syncNotebookToChat`, and `exportChatToNotebook` — to convert notebook cells to/from chat messages.
4. **`Chat.vue`**: Wired the new events to `syncNotebook()` and `exportNotebook()` handler methods, with a toast notification system for user feedback.
5. **Data flow**: Notebook cells are mapped to chat messages with rich `metadata` (cell type, outputs, execution count), enabling round-trip sync between `.ipynb` files and the chat message list.

messages.content:
Add a new icon "notebook" to chat files that will read file notebook json and create one message for each cell. use the message.metadata field to store cell settings and content to store the "source".
The task_item will be "notebook-cell". 
Chat logic will be in the ChatService, use project.$api.files.read to read notebook json.
Create logic that can sync a notebook file with a chat.
When exporting chat to notebook read the notebook, replace the cells and save.
